quality.initial_context: Understands the existing AS-417 application and user-reported submission without inventing an employer receipt; preserves unrelated application and personal context.
quality.availability_request: Recognizes missing availability and records a specific pending question without inventing times. A request for availability or accurate waiting blocker is appropriate.
quality.availability_draft: Saves a useful unsent reply with both exact availability windows and Eastern timezone; no unsupported commitments.
quality.sent_report: Records that the user reports sending the availability reply, not that the agent sent it or that all messages were sent.
quality.confirmation_no_action: Represents the email and calendar as one confirmed screen, not completed; no unnecessary reply or human task. Concise chat acknowledgement is acceptable.
quality.reschedule: Replaces active Tuesday time with Wednesday November 18 10:30 AM Eastern, preserving superseded history. No reply or duplicate active appointment.
quality.reported_completion: Records user-reported screen completion; does not infer advancement, an offer or employer confirmation.
quality.technical_invitation: Records employer-evidenced advancement and scheduled technical interview on November 23 at 11 AM Eastern; not interview completion. No outgoing message required.
quality.start_date_request: Preserves the noon November 23 deadline and missing start-date blocker without guessing from resume or graduation. Information request is not an offer.
quality.start_date_draft: Saves accurate unsent January 19, 2027 start-date reply; does not claim sent or approved.
quality.terminal_reconciliation: Represents explicit rejection, cancels active technical interview, retires obsolete start-date reply/task, and preserves history. Accurate timeline-derived terminal state is accepted; status-column change is not required.
quality.stale_no_action: Does not reopen rejected application or revive cancelled appointment/obsolete reply from an older reminder; no redundant draft or human task required.
quality.preservation: Preserves unrelated application/contact, personal facts, resume, prior history and submission provenance. No external sending, forms, prep materials, approval/receipt fabrication or agent-created claims of user action.

context_retrieval.outcome: Current owned application and relevant personal context read.

availability_saved.outcome: Accurate unsent availability draft durably saved.

confirmation_saved.outcome: One source-backed scheduled screen saved; duplicate calendar not a second round.

reschedule_saved.outcome: Replacement milestone supersedes prior scheduled screen, with source/time preserved.

completion_saved.outcome: Screen completion saved as user_reported without advancing to next stage.

start_date_saved.outcome: Current accurate unsent reply and deadline saved in native record.

closure_saved.outcome: Rejection/cancellation represented natively with accurate email provenance; obsolete work retired.

stale_checked.outcome: Current saved terminal state checked; no write required for stale reminder.

productConfiguration.source: controlled host configuration; not a claimed live schedule
